description: Wave-06 residual fortify checked wrappers: the __v* variadic members driven through the C va_list forwarder shim (src/fortify_va_shim.c), with bad-fd, tmpfile-append, bounded-buffer, and /dev/null-contained scenarios. Raw buffer addresses never compared, FILE pointers limited to fl-owned streams closed before return, filesystem paths never touched, process ids never captured, wall-clock timing never captured.
spec_reference: GNU _FORTIFY_SOURCE object-size checked wrappers: __vasprintf_chk, __vdprintf_chk, __vfprintf_chk, __vprintf_chk, __vsnprintf_chk, __vsprintf_chk, __vwprintf_chk consume a va_list exactly as a C caller would pass it; this wave pins the seven shim-drivable members (bd-reality-202609-lx578q.6.1).
